author: ladiosupp
name: Profile Recorder
description: Records full-point curves (machine telemetry + RAW scale + state events) for every espresso shot that HyperEx Pulse Filter does NOT record. HyperEx-managed shots and calibration runs stay exclusively in HyperEx's own history; this plugin drops its duplicate after matching HyperEx's diagnostic summary by start/end time. Keeps the newest 4 full records (new overwrites old) and serves them at /history-export in the same shape as HyperEx's export, so ProfileReplayer merges both sources with runId dedup. Read-only: never writes machine state, profiles or settings.

Enabled.label: Enable recording
Enabled.description: Record non-HyperEx espresso shots. Disable to stop capture; stored records remain available at /history-export.

SampleIntervalMs.label: Sample interval (ms)
SampleIntervalMs.description: Target cadence for combined machine/scale samples, same role as HyperEx DiagnosticSampleIntervalMs. Clamped 50-1000; 100 recommended.
